title: Relative inertia as the kernel of a stack morphism on automorphisms
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use categories over $\mathit{Sch}/S$ and functors over that base as in [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. For a functor $h:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ over the base, define $I_{\mathcal F/\mathcal G}$ as the full subcategory of the absolute inertia $I_{\mathcal F/S}$ [def-sfb-moduli-inertia] on the objects $(x,\alpha)$ satisfying $h(\alpha)=\mathrm{id}_{h(x)}$. Thus its arrows $a:(x,\alpha)\to(y,\beta)$ satisfy $a\alpha=\beta a$, and its base projection sends $(x,\alpha)$ to the base of $x$. Its inclusion in absolute inertia preserves $(x,\alpha)$ and $a$; its projection to $\mathcal F$ forgets $\alpha$. The neutral section sends $x$ to $(x,\mathrm{id}_x)$ and sends an arrow to itself. Represent the base scheme, as a category over $\mathit{Sch}/S$, by the identity functor of $\mathit{Sch}/S$; the structural morphism from $\mathcal F$ is its given base projection. These constructions do not choose any atlas or equivalence.
